name: XLA_ACCT_LINE_TYPES_B
description: This table stores journal line rules.

columns.name: APPLICATION_ID
columns.description: Functional area within a software suite of products. For example, Financials or Payroll.

columns.name: AMB_CONTEXT_CODE
columns.description: Accounting methods builder context.

columns.name: ENTITY_CODE
columns.description: Unique abbreviated name assigned to an entity and used for reporting or in reference to an option.

columns.name: EVENT_CLASS_CODE
columns.description: Unique abbreviated name assigned to an event class and used for reporting or in reference to an option.

columns.name: ACCOUNTING_LINE_TYPE_CODE
columns.description: Indicates whether the journal line rule is seeded.

columns.name: ACCOUNTING_LINE_CODE
columns.description: Abbreviated name of a rule to convert transactional data into a journal entry line.

columns.name: TRANSACTION_COA_ID
columns.description: Not currently used.

columns.name: ACCOUNTING_ENTRY_TYPE_CODE
columns.description: Indicates the accounting line type, for example actual, encumbrances or budget.

columns.name: NATURAL_SIDE_CODE
columns.description: Indicates whether the journal line rule is for debit, credit, or gain or loss.

columns.name: GL_TRANSFER_MODE_CODE
columns.description: General ledger transfer option.

columns.name: SWITCH_SIDE_FLAG
columns.description: Determines whether negative amounts will result in negative amounts on the same side or positive amounts on the opposite side.

columns.name: MERGE_DUPLICATE_CODE
columns.description: Summarizes journal lines by merging lines with the same values for a specified number of attributes within the same subledger journal entry.

columns.name: ENABLED_FLAG
columns.description: Indicates the status of a journal line rule.

columns.name: ACCOUNTING_CLASS_CODE
columns.description: Short name of a lookup type that is shared across application used to classify journal entry lines.

columns.name: CREATION_DATE
columns.description: Who column: indicates the date and time of the creation of the row.

columns.name: CREATED_BY
columns.description: Who column: indicates the user who created the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATE_DATE
columns.description: Who column: indicates the date and time of the last update of the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATED_BY
columns.description: Who column: indicates the user who last updated the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATE_LOGIN
columns.description: Who column: indicates the session login associated to the user who last updated the row.

columns.name: ROUNDING_CLASS_CODE
columns.description: Lookup value that is used with the transaction rounding reference to group journal lines and calculate transaction rounding.

columns.name: BUSINESS_METHOD_CODE
columns.description: Name of a method to associate journal lines of the same business flow class.

columns.name: BUSINESS_CLASS_CODE
columns.description: Unique abbreviated name assigned to a business class and used for reporting or in reference to an option.

columns.name: MULTIPERIOD_CLASS_CODE
columns.description: Unique abbreviated name assigned to a multiperiod accounting class and used to associate accrual journal to multiperiod accounting journal.

columns.name: MULTIPERIOD_OPTION_FLAG
columns.description: Multiperiod accounting option.  Possible values are Y (the journal line rule is used to create multiperiod accounting journal entries) and N (journal line rule is not used to create multiperiod accounting journal entries).

columns.name: MPA_OPTION_CODE
columns.description: Multiperiod accounting option.

columns.name: ENCUMBRANCE_TYPE_ID
columns.description: Identfier of an encumbrance category that allows you to track your encumbrances or anticipated expenditures according to your purchase approval process and to more accurately control your planned expenditures. Examples of encumbrance types are commitments (requisition encumbrances) and obligations (purchase order encumbrances).

columns.name: GAIN_OR_LOSS_FLAG
columns.description: Subledger gain and loss indicator.

columns.name: CROSS_LEDGER_BALANCING_FLAG
columns.description: Cross ledger balancing indicator.

columns.name: OBJECT_VERSION_NUMBER
columns.description: Used to implement optimistic locking. This number is incremented every time that the row is updated. The number is compared at the start and end of a transaction to detect whether another session has updated the row since it was queried.

columns.name: SEED_DATA_SOURCE
columns.description: Source of seed data record. A value of 'BULK_SEED_DATA_SCRIPT' indicates that record was bulk loaded. Otherwise, specifies the name of the seed data file.

columns.name: ORA_SEED_SET1
columns.description: Oracle internal use only. Indicates the edition-based redefinition (EBR) context of the row for SET1. Context values are Y or N.

columns.name: ORA_SEED_SET2
columns.description: Oracle internal use only. Indicates the edition-based redefinition (EBR) context of the row for SET2. Context values are Y or N.
